---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num, name = "gps_fixes") |>
  arrange(month_num)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarize(
    observations = sum(!is.na(speed)),
    missing = sum(is.na(speed)),
    minimum = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(speed, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(speed, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30) |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1.1,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard speed distributions by month",
    subtitle = "GPS fixes with speeds of 30 m/s or less",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```
